function_independence: Every function is evaluated independently; no trainee function may call another trainee function.
import_policy: any valid PySpark import style; evaluator uses functions as F and does not wildcard-import pyspark.sql.functions
report_format: [PASS] Visible Test Case N Passed: name / [FAIL] Visible Test Case N Failed: name with Expected/Actual/Reason/Fix detail lines
runner_contract: Candidate logic failures are recorded in test_report.log and do not produce a non-zero process exit code; true invalid report-generation may return non-zero.
qa_gate: Reference solution must pass all 6 tests in strict QA mode before production release.
